# FG-AGENT-0004

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `publish_refused_when_pipeline_not_green` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この部品の版は、まだ公開できる状態ではありません（CI が成功していない、または main に入っていないコミットの tag です）。CI を緑にしてから、もう一度公開してください。
- en: This part version cannot be published yet (its CI has not succeeded, or the tag names a commit that is not on the default branch). Make CI green, then publish again.
- id: Versi bagian ini belum dapat diterbitkan (CI-nya belum berhasil, atau tag menunjuk commit yang tidak ada di cabang default). Buat CI hijau, lalu terbitkan lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 16 A5 (ADR-0032 Amendment A5): `POST /api/v1/agent-parts/{slug}/versions` refused the tag because what it names has not been checked: `reason=not_on_default_branch` (the tagged commit is not reachable from the parts repository's default branch: it never went through a merge request), `pipeline_missing` (no pipeline of the parts project ran on that commit), `pipeline_not_green` (the newest pipeline on that commit is not `success`; `status` names it). Decided after `authorize()` and before anything is signed or written. Nothing was published.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The route's log event carries `slug`, `version`, `tag`, `sha`, `reason`, `pipeline_id` and `status`. `gstn ci list --project <parts project>` shows the commit's pipelines; `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> <default branch>` on the parts repository tells whether the commit was merged.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server: merge the part's change through a merge request, wait for (or re-run) its pipeline on the tagged commit until it succeeds, then publish again. A tag made on an unmerged commit is deleted and made again on the merged one.
